title: Mirabel and the Contact
author: Kestrel Delacroix
blurb: Lior Voss, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
